$Comment: The Yeti (the role Christmas_Yeti), the Yeti Cave's boss. His fight's script finds him through this group: to bind him when he rises without a spawn marker, to hold him through the fight, and to clear him away when the fight resets. ZigRank Boss counts him as a boss for CommonLib's crowd-control rule (a CommonLib without that rule ignores the tag): a talent's stun, root, slow or push never lands on him, an ability's own does, and a taunt always does. His White Wolves stay ordinary (Christmas_Yeti_Adds_Group). No reputation names this group, and Santa's Nice List counts none of it. Add a role id here, written *<id>, if the Yeti gains another form. Each role id is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role (and only it: Christmas_Yeti_Wolf does not end in Christmas_Yeti), while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
